instruction: Go to FlightAware's community forum and access the General discussion category.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to FlightAware discussions and access the General category. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the correct category URL is opened. Similar complexity to original - requires navigating through website sections.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic can semantically verify the instruction - checks if correct forum category URL is loaded
Metric correctly compares URLs using compare_urls to verify General discussion category is accessed
Coverage is complete - both 'navigate to forum' and 'access General category' requirements verified by checking final URL
Expected URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/c/general/7' appears correct for FlightAware General discussion category (Discourse forum pattern)
Minor concern: get_active_tab_info unnecessarily reloads the page by navigating to the URL (line 830 in chrome.py), which could theoretically cause issues though unlikely for this static forum URL
The getter's own docstring warns about reload behavior potentially causing page changes with dynamic URLs
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using result type 'active_tab_url' instead of 'active_tab_info' to avoid unnecessary page reload - only URL verification is needed, not full page content
The simpler get_active_url_from_accessTree getter would be more appropriate as it reads the URL directly from accessibility tree without reloading
